long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Glasgow, Barrowman studied accountancy at the University of Glasgow, qualified as a chartered accountant and joined private-equity group 3i. After leaving to establish a corporate-finance practice, he sold that business and founded Aston Ventures in 1999. The investment vehicle acquired and operated a portfolio of industrial companies before broadening into technology and property.

After moving to the Isle of Man, Barrowman assembled the Knox group around private equity, investment management, wealth planning and fiduciary services. His roles have included founder, chairman, controlling shareholder and family-office principal across a complex network of companies. A PPE procurement consortium he led later became the subject of a civil judgment and continuing criminal investigation; he has denied criminal wrongdoing.

Born in Glasgow, Barrowman studied accountancy at the University of Glasgow, qualified as a chartered accountant and joined private-equity group 3i. After moving to the Isle of Man, Barrowman assembled the Knox group around private equity, investment management, wealth planning and fiduciary services. His roles have included founder, chairman, controlling shareholder and family-office principal across a complex network of companies. A PPE procurement consortium he led later became the subject of a civil judgment and continuing criminal investigation; he has denied criminal wrongdoing.
